narrative.title: The One-Way Conveyor Belt
narrative.scenario: A factory line moves crates onto a conveyor at one end and unloads them from the other, so the crate that arrived first is always the crate that leaves first. The belt controller accepts two commands: drop a crate onto the loading end, or release whatever is waiting at the unloading end. Your job is to replay a command log and report what each release yields.
narrative.inputFormat: A list of operations, each either ["push", value] to enqueue or ["pop"] to dequeue.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the list of values produced by every pop operation, in order; a pop on an empty queue yields -1.
constraints: The structure behaves as FIFO: the earliest pushed element is the first popped

testCases.explanation: First-in-first-out: the 2 leaves before the 3, then the 4 follows.
The single crate leaves first; the next release finds the belt empty.

Level 2: Track two cursors — one for the next departure, one for the next arrival.
